findings.summary: e2e checks for AC-ra-01/02/03/04/19/58 (pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/report.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts) were not run: ReportCenterPage is not routed yet because src/App.tsx is outside this unit's allowed files, and the e2e specs belong to integration.
Smoke test in the Play dev-link webview (open the center, toggle answers, Exportar PDF, Abrir PDF, Mostrar na pasta) was not run: it needs the route wiring and a running Play instance.

The center lists the company's completed diagnoses with getTimeline (src/api/historyApi.ts, the existing v1 history route). IF-001/IF-002 have no route that lists diagnoses. Every report and file call uses only IF-001 (getReportPreview, exportReportFile) and IF-002 (openSavedFile, revealSavedFile).

The 'Relatório de evolução' option is always off for now. Below 2 completed diagnoses it shows the BR-ra-02 sentence. With 2 or more it says the evolution comes in a later version, because ReportSelection has no evolution kind yet. ReportOptions takes an evolutionSupported prop that phase 2 can turn on.
The brand line in the options ('Marca na capa e no rodapé') was left out: it belongs to CAP-ra-brand (phase 2). The sheet already draws the cover brand from the document's cover block.

evidence.result: exit 0; the report-sheet/sheet-* CSS was compiled into the bundle; only the existing >500 kB chunk warning

evidence.summary: Report calls go only through src/api/reportApi.ts (getReportPreview with AbortSignal, exportReportFile) and src/api/filesApi.ts (openSavedFile, revealSavedFile, OpenFailureDetails.directory). Pages are drawn from ReportDocument/ReportPage/ReportBlock (shared/report/reportDocument.ts), with colors from PAPER_PALETTE/PAPER_TONE_* (shared/report/paperPalette.ts). Non-cover pages print page.title, like pdfRenderer.drawPage. A riskMatrix followed by a riskList share one spread, like drawRiskSpread. The footer reads 'Página N de M'.

AC-ra-01: ReportCenterPage is a company layout child (useCompanyOutlet) with options on the left and the paged preview on the right; ?diagnostico= picks the diagnosis. AC-ra-02: useReportPreview fetches on every selection change, aborts the call in flight, and findChangedPageId marks the changed page (JSON diff per page.id); ReportPreview remounts that sheet with the .is-reprinted band and scrolls to it. AC-ra-03: the empty state has 'Começar o diagnóstico' or 'Continuar o diagnóstico' and no export; Evolução is aria-disabled with the BR-ra-02 sentence. AC-ra-04: loading uses StatusView aria-busy and the .report-pages aria-busy skeleton; errors use role=alert with 'Tentar de novo' and show no pages. AC-ra-19: ReportDelivery shows the write_failed message and 'Tentar de novo', and nothing else changes. AC-ra-58: the reprint (700 ms), page entry (220 ms), skeleton pulse and switch transitions are only under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).

messages.text: Wire the route in src/App.tsx (not in this unit's allowed files): inside <Route path="empresa/:companyId" element={<CompanyPage .../>}> add <Route path="relatorios" element={<ReportCenterPage />} /> with import { ReportCenterPage } from "@/features/reports/ReportCenterPage". The page reads ?diagnostico=<id> to pre-select the result's diagnosis. Then run: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/report.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts, and the dev-link smoke in the Play (Relatórios -> toggle answers -> Exportar PDF -> Abrir PDF / Mostrar na pasta).

Stable selectors for e2e: report-type-diagnosis, report-type-evolution (aria-disabled), report-evolution-note, report-diagnosis (select), report-include-answers (label around a checkbox), report-preview, report-sheet (one per page; aria-label 'Página N de M: {page.title}', data-page-id; the changed page has class is-reprinted), report-export, report-pdf-saved, report-open-pdf, report-show-folder, report-open-error, report-export-error, report-export-retry, reports-empty, reports-loading, reports-error, report-preview-error. The preview and export calls go to /api/reports/preview and /api/reports/export, so a test can route them to simulate failures.

ReportDelivery is reusable for the inline delivery on the result screen: <ReportDelivery onExport={() => exportReport(diagnosisId)} /> (props: onExport(): Promise<ReportExport>, disabled?, className?). It renders the 'Exportar PDF' button (data-aioson-id report-export), then 'Salvando…', then 'PDF salvo' with Abrir PDF/Mostrar na pasta, and the write failure with 'Tentar de novo'. To link to the center on a diagnosis, use #/empresa/{companyId}/relatorios?diagnostico={diagnosisId}.

ReportOptions has an evolutionSupported prop (default false) and hard-selects 'diagnosis'. When the evolution selection is added to ReportSelection, make the type controlled (value + onTypeChange), add the De/Para selects, and pass evolutionSupported from ReportCenterPage.

ReportSheet CoverBlock already draws brand.logoDataUrl (img alt=""), brand.name, contactLine and credit from the cover block. The sheet's paper CSS variables (--p-*) come from PAPER_PALETTE in the PAPER_STYLE constant.
